message: エスケープ・ゴート

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Azel. Good morning」

name: Synn
message: 「Is he asleep?」

name: Azel
message: 「Asleep, you say?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sleeping feels soo~o good~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the Student Council President, so no napping during the day」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it works~」
Being Student Council President is tough.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Azel. Where are you going?」

name: Synn
message: 「Class is starting~, and there he goes」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe the restroom?」

name: Synn
message: 「I see」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Azel never ended up coming back, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it really okay for him to act like that right after transferring in」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Escaping from class makes him a bad boy, doesn't it」

name: Synn
message: 「Seriously, it's such a waste of tuition」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We should definitely say something to him, right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course!!

name: Lolotte
message: Doing what is right is our mission as the Student Council. Sabotage will not be tolerated」

name: Synn
message: 「You're really fired up, Lolotte」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lately she's even been getting here earlier than us. Very admirable」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes.

name: Lolotte
message: After all, I sneak out of homeroom to come here」

name: Synn
message: 「You shouldn't ignore your own faults like that」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm sorry」

name: Misa
message: 「Hello」

name: Ria
message: 「Hello~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, here they come」

name: Lolotte
message: 「For now, everything we've come up with so far has been summarized like this」

name: Ria
message: 「Thank you, Lolotte-chan」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Not at all」

name: Misa
message: 「...I see. So on top of how we've done things until now, we'll have the clubs and folks from the shopping district lend us a hand too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「With this, it looks like we'll get way, way more visitors coming」
The newly reborn Charity Bazaar. As far as the content goes, I think we've gathered plenty of ideas.
However, something is missing.

name: Synn
message: 「Since we're going through all this trouble, I want to push the feeling that it's different from before more to the forefront, though...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, yeah. That'd probably catch everyone's interest better too」

name: Ria
message: 「Then why don't we just go ahead and change the name too?」

name: Synn
message: 「The name...」

name: Ria
message: 「Instead of Charity Bazaar, we'll come up with another name for it」

name: Synn
message: 「Nice idea!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then how about Super Charity Bazaar, or perhaps Special Charity Bazaar!?」

name: Misa
message: 「That doesn't really feel much different」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you have time to make rude remarks, please think of something yourself, Vice President」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You're right」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, you can't let them beat you either, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Hrmmm...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey. Do you remember what you said to all the students during your inauguration speech?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If I recall correctly, it was 'Leave your sparkling school life snugly in the hands of the Ryuusei Student Council!', right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's it!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's a little different, though\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You did declare it to the whole student body, after all. Synn's catchphrase」

name: Ria
message: 「If you want the entire student body to accept it, I think you should make good use of that declaration」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then, how about something like, 'The Whole Student Body Cried!'?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not making use of it at all」

name: Synn
message: 「Sparkling and shining... Ryuusei Academy... festival... fun...」

name: Misa
message: 「Sparkling, twinkling, heart―throbbing, you and me―」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Wait, something like this is too embarrassing to say out loud!」

name: Synn
message: 「I've got it!」

name: Synn
message: 「How about 'Ryuusei Sparkle Festival'!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, sounds pretty good」

name: Misa
message: 「Guh, I was a tenth of a second too slow...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then, let's add that name to the proposal--」

name: Synn
message: 「All done!」

name: Ria
message: 「Congrats~~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sparkle Festival...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Or 'Sparkle Fest' for short?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「With this, Sparkle Fest is already in the bag!!」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you talking about? The real battle starts now. After all, we have to take on the teachers and the entire student body」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hiee~u. You mustn't get into fights~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're working hard even with all these hurdles ahead」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course I am. Defeat is not an option for me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even though it seems you can't beat the President?」

name: Misa
message: 「...True. A draw doesn't count as a win, does it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm moved by that spirit of refusing to admit defeat no matter what. I won't turn my back either--I'll throw myself into the fray!」

name: Synn
message: 「Listen, Nanaka. We can't even run away in the first place」

name: Misa
message: 「Come now, we haven't a moment to spare. Let's hurry and have the teachers take a look」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright. We're definitely gonna win!」

name: Helena
message: 「Foh-foh-foh-foh-foh」
Suddenly, the final boss appeared.

name: Helena
message: 「Fah-fah-fah-fah-fah」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm scared, Big Sis\s01」

name: Helena
message: 「'For someone talking about going for a stroll, you've sure got a dangerous look on your face...'」

name: Helena
message: 「'Yes, just like a beast stalking its prey'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Th-th-th-that's not true at a~ll」

name: Helena
message: 「That look on your face... Don't tell me you're plotting something」

name: Lolotte
message: 「*Flinch*, th-th-th, that's, n-n-n-not true, I'm telling you~!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan, you're totally busted」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. It's not like we're doing anything bad」

name: Helena
message: 「It doesn't look like you're doing anything right either, though?」

name: Misa
message: 「What do you mean by that?」

name: Helena
message: 「Nip the spark in the bud... as they say」

name: Ria
message: 「B-Big Sis...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan. Would you mind showing me what you're holding in your hand?」

name: Misa
message: 「Please wait. This is something to be submitted to the teachers, not something to show to Chairwoman Helena」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, aren't you bold」

name: Misa
message: 「If afterward is acceptable, we will gladly show you as much as you like」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't see why not. Go ahead」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey, wait!」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's not a proposal everyone can get behind, we'll just rewrite it. Back to the drawing board」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not the kind of weak plan that'll just get shot down by Helena, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then have some confidence, come on」
Without changing her expression, Helena takes the proposal from me and flips through the pages while giving it a light glance.

name: Helena
message: 「Who's the fire safety supervisor?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Helena
message: 「If there's any chance you'll be using open flames, you absolutely cannot forget to assign someone in charge of that」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, I had no idea--」

name: Misa
message: 「So that's how it works...」

name: Helena
message: 「Also, the donation percentage isn't something for you to decide on your own. Settle that in consultation with the other party」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Y-Yes, ma'am!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn. Did Helena seriously just read the whole thing with that quick glance?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it sure looks like it」

name: Misa
message: 「So... how does it look?」

name: Helena
message: 「Let's see. I'm confiscating this」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way. Was there something wrong with it...」

name: Helena
message: 「Aside from the points I just mentioned, it's mostly fine」

name: Misa
message: 「Then why?!」

name: Helena
message: 「I'll fill in the missing parts and try negotiating with the teachers myself」

name: Helena
message: 「You've probably been so caught up making this that you've left everything you actually need to do undone, right? First things first, finish all of that」

name: Helena
message: 「By the time you're done with that--you're going to get busy preparing for Kirafes, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y... yes!」

name: Misa
message: 「Helena-san. Thank you very much!」
We all bow and see her off.

name: Synn
message: 「I pray... for your success!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ha-ha! Leave it to me!」
She was in an unusually good mood.

name: Synn
message: 「Do everything we can and leave the rest to fate! Let's hurry up and finish our usual activities so we can get right to preparing for Kirafes!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, today's another day--」

name: Everyone
message: 「Let's do our best!」
